etymology: a prolonged form of an otherwise obsolete verb
avSummary: speak 244, say 15, tell 12, talk 11, preach 6, utter 4, misc 3, vr speak 1
definition:
1) to utter a voice or emit a sound
 2) to speak
    2a) to use the tongue or the faculty of speech
    2b) to utter articulate sounds
 3) to talk
 4) to utter, tell
 5) to use words in order to declare one's mind and disclose one's thoughts
    5a) to speak
